title: 2010–2014 Portuguese financial crisis
summary: The years from 2010 to 2014 are the sharpest stretch of a longer Portuguese downturn, which the article this record is drafted from dates from 2001 and treats as ending somewhere around 2016 or 2017. The Great Recession reached Portugal in 2008; by the spring of 2011 the state could no longer repay or refinance its government debt without outside assistance. The period contains the international programme of 2011 to 2014 and the austerity that came with it, both of which this atlas holds as records of their own. It is here as the economic ground under them, and its dates are the article's rather than any economist's.
